field_descriptions.event: The event that triggered this delivery.
field_descriptions.event.id: Event id, the same on every retry (also the webhook-id header).
field_descriptions.event.type: Event name, e.g. email.received or sms.status.
field_descriptions.data: The email, SMS or delivery the event is about; its shape follows the event.
field_descriptions.data.from.name: Sender display name, may be empty.
field_descriptions.data.to: Recipients of the email, a list.
field_descriptions.data.to[].name: Recipient display name, may be empty.
field_descriptions.data.subject: Email subject.
field_descriptions.data.text_body: Plain text body of the email.
field_descriptions.data.html_body: HTML body of the email, or empty.
field_descriptions.data.tags: Tags on the email, a list of text.
field_descriptions.data.extracted: What the extractor found in the email or SMS.
field_descriptions.data.extracted.otp: One-time codes found in the message, a list.
field_descriptions.data.extracted.links: Links found in the message, a list.
field_descriptions.data.provider_id: Provider-style message id, e.g. Twilio's SM... SID.
field_descriptions.data.status: SMS delivery status: queued, sent, delivered, undelivered, failed or received.
field_descriptions.data.error_code: Provider error code of a failed SMS, or empty.
field_descriptions.vars: Variables: this endpoint's, then global ones, then SENDMOCK_VAR_*.
field_descriptions.endpoint.name: Endpoint name.
field_descriptions.delivery.attempt: Attempt number, 1 for the first try.
field_descriptions.rule: The rule that fired; empty for manual sends.
field_descriptions.rule.name: Rule name.
field_descriptions.sendmock.http_url: Base URL of the web UI and API, e.g. to link to the message.
field_descriptions.request_id: A unique id for this delivery, stable across retries.
field_descriptions.body_fields: In header templates: the rendered body fields, e.g. for signatures.

functions.name: now_unix
functions.description: The current time as Unix seconds.

functions.name: random_string
functions.description: Random letters and digits, e.g. for a nonce or token.

functions.name: twilio_signature
functions.description: The X-Twilio-Signature for the request, as Twilio computes it.

functions.name: mailgun_signature
functions.description: Mailgun's HMAC signature over timestamp and token.

functions.name: svix_signature
functions.description: A Svix signature header, as Resend sends it.

functions.name: uuid
functions.description: A random UUID, e.g. for a transmission id.

functions.name: random_hex
functions.description: Random lowercase hex digits, e.g. for a signature.

functions.name: now_iso
functions.description: The current time as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

functions.name: stripe_signature
functions.description: A Stripe-Signature header (t=...,v1=...), as Stripe sends it.

filters.name: default
filters.description: The fallback when the value is missing or empty; no warning is given.

filters.name: json
filters.description: The value as JSON text, for objects and lists.

filters.name: urlencode
filters.description: Percent-encodes the value for form bodies and query strings.

filters.name: sendgrid_event
filters.description: An event type as SendGrid names it: email.bounced becomes bounced.

filters.name: ses_type
filters.description: An event type as Amazon SES names it: email.bounced becomes Bounced.

filters.name: resend_type
filters.description: An event type as Resend names it: email.bounced stays email.bounced.
